title: Section 106 BNS — Causing death by negligence

content.heading: Causing death by negligence
content.text: Whoever causes death of any person by doing any rash or negligent act not amounting to culpable homicide shall be punished as enacted. Separate clauses deal with registered medical practitioners and with flight from the scene in specified cases. This is the successor of IPC 304A. Read the official text.
